title: One Open Review Program per Member — Utilization Management Program Enrollment Rule
content:
**Rule.** A member holds at most one Utilization Management Program review program that is not terminated, tied to their open plan enrollment. A new review program may be opened only when no review program of that member is pending effective or active.

The number of review programs that are not terminated is capped at 1 per member.

## Basis of the judgement

- **What is checked:** the member's existing review programs and the status each one shows in the system records — pending effective, active or terminated. A caller's description of their coverage does not replace what the records show.
- **Whose programs:** the programs of the same member (the same customer) for whom the new program would be opened.
- **When:** before the new program is opened.

## Status table

| Member's existing review programs | New review program may be opened |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| Only terminated programs | Yes |
| At least one pending effective program | No |
| At least one active program | No |

### Hypothetical cases

- A member whose earlier review program ended (terminated) when a previous plan enrollment ended, and who now has a new plan enrollment, may have a new review program opened: no program of theirs is pending effective or active.
- A member whose review program is pending effective because their plan coverage starts next month already holds the one program allowed; a second program is not opened beside it.
